style: Original 3D adult black comedy; vivid color, crisp physical action
subject: ONE grey goose on a narrow ledge INSIDE a square pit, wearing a large COBALT-BLUE vest and red-purple party cone at first
second_characters: ONE mole foreman in a vivid YELLOW jacket and ONE white hardhat at the rim at first
props: ONE steel shovel, ONE white hardhat, ONE red-purple party cone. One owner each.
environment: Outdoor plaza worksite, square pit of bright orange bare CLAY, turquoise rails and magenta bunting. No pool, tiles, fruit or extra characters.
lighting: Bright warm key on both faces; cyan rim left and magenta rim right. Cobalt and yellow cover large visible areas of the characters in every shot.
motion_rule: Full-bleed vertical 9:16. Camera ALREADY flies fast at frame zero, real travel and parallax. Sharp paths end on action; four readable moving close-ups. No black edges.

audio.delivery: ONE dry goose voice, 0.7 to 8.0 s, exact words once; free visible beak during speech; silent final 2 s

timeline.a: Mole ALREADY jams shovel against goose's LEFT wing; goose's RIGHT wing forms a C-shaped worker's grip on handle from frame zero through 0.35s, then SLAPS it away by 0.7s. Cone on goose; helmet on mole.
timeline.c: Camera ALREADY races forward beside extreme close-up C-shaped grip from frame zero, past foreground rail with violent parallax; ends at shovel slap.

timeline.a: Mole shoves SAME shovel toward goose again. Goose on inner ledge hooks shaft with LEFT wing, unable to escape; hats and positions unchanged.
timeline.c: Camera whips low around goose's beak then rushes to wing on shaft, a moving close-up.

timeline.a: Mole leans down: goose's RIGHT wing snatches his ONLY hardhat; the same shovel bumps goose's cone onto mole's now bare head. Goose holds helmet; mole wears cone and holds shovel. Both stay in place.
timeline.c: Camera dives from foreground rail into tight close-up of both hats crossing at rim.

timeline.a: Goose puts stolen helmet on his own head just as mole strikes with SAME shovel; steel glances off hardhat. Goose is still IN pit; mole in cone still ABOVE.
timeline.c: Camera rolls under shovel blade into close-up of helmet deflecting the strike.

timeline.a: Mole pins goose's wing with shovel; goose wedges its shaft under clay rim with free wing. Helmet on goose; cone on mole.
timeline.c: Camera whips down past foreground clay to wing levering shaft and mole's planted boot.

timeline.a: ONE decisive reversal: goose yanks shaft and FLIES out; mole's boot slips and he falls INTO pit WITH the ONE shovel. Goose wears helmet, mole wears cone. Loudest thud at 7.8s.
timeline.c: Camera plunges to slipping boot then rockets back and rises with goose, both paths clear.

timeline.a: Mole below angrily THROWS the SAME shovel upward toward goose. Goose above thinks he escaped work; single shovel travels visibly between them.
timeline.c: Camera dives after shovel then swings overhead to track its upward path against colorful rails.

timeline.a: Goose reflexively CATCHES shovel in EXACT SAME C-shaped worker's grip as frame one. Final: shovel in blue wing, mole empty-pawed below; eyes widen.
timeline.c: Camera snaps into the SAME low close-up angle on blue wing grip, goose's horrified eyes behind it; no fade.

negative_prompt: subtitles, text overlays, watermark, English speech, static opening, slow drift, digital zoom, black borders, horizontal framing, duplicate shovel, duplicate helmet, duplicate cone, extra wings, extra paws, teleporting props, fruit, pool, blood
